experiences.name: Cherry Blossom Viewing in Maruyama Park
experiences.description: Experience the iconic Japanese tradition of 'hanami' (flower viewing) beneath hundreds of blooming cherry blossom trees. Maruyama Park in Kyoto is home to a famous weeping cherry tree illuminated at night. Families can enjoy picnics, street food stalls, and traditional performances in a festive atmosphere surrounded by locals and travelers alike.

experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the bustling Tsukiji Outer Market, one of Japan's most famous food destinations. Sample fresh sushi, tamagoyaki (sweet rolled omelette), matcha treats, and grilled seafood skewers from local vendors. A guided family-friendly walking tour introduces the history of Japanese culinary culture and lets everyone taste their way through authentic Tokyo street food.
experiences.location: Tsukiji Outer Market, Chuo City, Tokyo

experiences.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum and Park Visit
experiences.description: A deeply moving and historically significant experience for families, the Hiroshima Peace Memorial Museum chronicles the events of August 6, 1945, and promotes a message of peace and reconciliation. Walk through the Peace Memorial Park, see the iconic A-Bomb Dome, and fold paper cranes at the Children's Peace Monument. An essential cultural and historical experience that resonates with visitors of all ages.
experiences.location: Peace Memorial Park, Naka Ward, Hiroshima

experiences.name: Asakusa Temple and Traditional Craft Workshop
experiences.description: Visit the iconic Senso-ji Temple, Tokyo's oldest and most visited Buddhist temple, and stroll through the Nakamise shopping street lined with traditional snacks and souvenirs. Afterward, join a family-friendly hands-on workshop nearby to try traditional Japanese crafts such as origami, calligraphy, or making a daruma doll. A perfect blend of living history and interactive cultural immersion.

experiences.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove and Togetsukyo Bridge Exploration
experiences.description: Wander through the ethereal Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, one of Japan's most photographed natural wonders, where towering bamboo stalks create a magical canopy overhead. Extend the adventure with a family rickshaw ride through the scenic area, cross the historic Togetsukyo Bridge over the Oi River, and visit the nearby Tenryu-ji Temple garden with stunning cherry blossom views in spring. A full sensory experience combining nature, history, and culture.
